transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My doctor wanted me to come in because she’s concerned my meal planning has gotten too strict. I don’t really see it that way exactly — I usually have yogurt for breakfast, and if I’m busy I’ll skip lunch. Then I make a pretty measured dinner so the day feels orderly.
Do you have concerns about gaining weight or feel that your body shape or size is a significant issue for you?

Yes… I do worry about it. If I weigh myself and the scale is even up a pound after a normal dinner or eating at a restaurant, I get this sudden panic, like I’ve lost control. Then I feel like I need to make up for it the next day.
When you feel like you've lost control around food or after eating, do you ever make yourself sick, use laxatives, or exercise excessively to compensate?

I’m not really sure what counts as “excessively.” I don’t make myself sick or anything like that. I haven’t used laxatives to make up for eating. If I feel like I overdid it, I mostly just try to be more careful afterward.
When you say you 'try to be more careful' after overeating, does that involve skipping meals, severely restricting your food intake, or doing significantly more exercise than usual?

Yes, I suppose it does. I’ll keep breakfast to something small, usually yogurt, and if I’m busy I’ll just skip lunch. Then dinner is very measured, so I feel like the day is back under control. I don’t really think of it as severe, but my doctor seems worried it’s gotten too tight.
Have you ever had episodes where you feel like you're eating a large amount of food in a short period of time and feel like you can't stop yourself, even if you wanted to?

I don’t think so. I mean, I might eat more than I planned sometimes, especially if I’m out or it’s a bigger meal, but I wouldn’t say it feels like I can’t stop myself. It’s more that afterward I worry I had too much.

Have you had episodes where you eat a noticeably larger amount of food than most people would eat in a similar period of time and feel that you can’t stop eating or control how much you eat during those times?
No, not really. I don’t have times where I’m eating huge amounts and feel like I can’t stop. Sometimes I eat more than I meant to, but it’s not like I’m out of control during it.
Have you ever had times where you felt you ate a lot more than you intended, even if you didn't feel completely out of control, but afterward felt really upset or guilty about it?

Yes… that happens. Like if I have a normal dinner out or a restaurant meal and then the scale is up even a pound the next morning, I get this sudden panic. I feel like I’ve lost control, and then I feel like I have to make up for it the next day.
Do you have episodes where you eat more than you intended, even if you don’t feel like you can’t stop, but afterwards feel really upset or guilty about how much you ate?

Yes. It’s usually after what other people would probably call a normal dinner, especially at a restaurant. If I weigh myself the next morning and it’s even up a pound, I get this sharp panic, like I’ve lost control and need to correct it the next day.
When you eat more than you intended, does it usually happen in a single, short period of time — like within a couple of hours — or is it more spread out through the day?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to whether it’s within a couple of hours or spread out. I usually just notice afterward that I ate more than I planned.
When you eat more than you intended, does it usually happen all at once, like in one sitting or within a couple of hours, rather than spread out through the day?

I’m honestly not sure. I don’t think I’ve tracked it that closely. Sometimes it feels like it was just that meal, but I can’t say for sure whether it’s always within a couple hours or more spread out.
Do you ever have times where you eat a larger amount of food than you planned, even if you don’t feel like you can’t stop, but it feels like more than most people would eat in that time?

I don’t really know. I mean, it can feel like too much to me, but I’m not sure if it’s actually more than most people would eat in that same amount of time. I mostly notice that it was more than I planned.
When you eat more than you intended, even if it’s not a huge amount, do you ever feel like you couldn’t control how much you were eating in that moment?

I’m not sure I’d describe it as not being able to control it. It’s more like I realize afterward that I ate more than I meant to. In the moment, I don’t always think about whether I could stop or not.
When you eat more than you intended, does it usually happen all in one sitting or within a short window of time, like a couple of hours?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close enough attention to whether it’s all within a couple hours or more spread out. It just feels afterward like I had more than I meant to.
When you eat more than you intended, even if you don’t realize it at the time, do you ever feel like you couldn’t control how much you were eating once you started?

I’m not sure. I don’t usually experience it as “I can’t stop” once I start. It’s more that later I think, why did I eat that much, or that was more than I meant to. But in the moment, I don’t really notice a loss of control.
Have you ever had times where you ate a lot more than you planned, even if you didn’t feel like you couldn’t stop, but afterward felt really bad about it, even if it was just one meal?

I don’t know. I mean, I’ve had times where afterward I felt like I ate more than I meant to, and I didn’t feel good about that. But I’m not sure I’d call it a lot more, or like a specific one-meal thing. It’s more just feeling upset with myself afterward.
When you eat more than you intended, even if just slightly, do you ever feel like you couldn't control how much you were eating once you started, even for a short time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I might eat a little more than I meant to, but I don’t really feel like I’ve lost control once I start. It’s more something I notice afterward.
When you eat more than you intended, even if just a little, do you ever feel like you couldn't control how much you were eating once you started, even for a short time?
No, I don’t think so. I might feel afterward like I ate more than I wanted, but during it I don’t really feel like I can’t control it, even briefly.
